brief.headline: Apollo, UDR Partner on $2B Multifamily Joint Venture
bullets: Real Estate: Multifamily real estate investment trust (REIT) UDR has partnered with alternative asset manager Apollo Global Management on a $2 billion multifamily joint venture, the firms announced Wednesday.

M&A & Buyouts: Apollo Global Management and Blackstone are in preliminary discussions with the National Football League (NFL) to become approved private equity investors eligible to acquire minority stakes in US football franchises, according to a report by Bloomberg.

Earnings & AUM: Blackstone, the world’s biggest alternative asset manager, saw its assets under management (AUM) top $1.37tn in the third quarter, while its credit and insurance assets reached $480bn.
Insurance & Retirement: Carlyle and tech retirement platform Basic Capital have announced a collaboration to accelerate private markets investing to a broader set of American pension savers.
Fundraising: Blackstone has held the final close of Blackstone Energy Transition Partners V at $8.7 billion.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The S&P 500 stands at 7,757.17 (up 0.6% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 16.7, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.12% (down 3 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.32 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.27%, near long-run norms (down 6 bps on the prior reading).
